image.name: planka
image.description: [Planka](https://github.com/plankanban/planka/) is an elegant open source project tracking tool.

changelog.desc: Rebase to Alpine 3.23. Updates for v2. Users should update `TRUST_PROXY` to use `true`/`false` instead of `1`/`0`.

env_vars.name: BASE_URL
env_vars.desc: The URL you will use to access planka including protocol, and port if not 80/443.

env_vars.name: DATABASE_URL
env_vars.desc: Postgres database URL. Special characters must be [url encoded](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Percent-encoding).

env_vars.name: SECRET_KEY
env_vars.desc: Session encryption key, recommended 32-64 character alphanumeric.

env_vars.name: TRUST_PROXY
env_vars.desc: Set to `true` to trust upstream proxies if reverse proxying.

env_vars.name: DEFAULT_LANGUAGE
env_vars.desc: This sets the default language for sending notifications per user (if a user hasn't selected a language) and per board.

volumes.desc: Local path for planka config files.

image.title: Planka
image.setup_instructions:
Web UI is accessible at http://SERVERIP:PORT. An external postgres database is required.

Once you've run your first time setup you can safely remove the DEFAULT_ environment variables. They will overwrite any changes made to the default user in the web UI (passwords, display names, etc.) on startup if left in place.

### Migration from Official Image

Copy your `user-avatars`, `background-images`, and `attachments` folders to your new `/config` mount so that it looks like:

```text
/config
├── attachments
└── images
    ├── background-images
    └── user-avatars
```

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  planka:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/planka:latest
    container_name: planka
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - BASE_URL=https://planka.example.com
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@planka-db:5432/planka
      - DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL=demo@demo.demo
      - DEFAULT_ADMIN_USERNAME=demo
      - DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD=demo
      - "DEFAULT_ADMIN_NAME=Demo User"
      - SECRET_KEY=notasecretkey
      - TRUST_PROXY=false
      - DEFAULT_LANGUAGE=en-US #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/planka/data:/config
    ports:
      - 1337:1337
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=planka \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e BASE_URL=https://planka.example.com \
  -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@planka-db:5432/planka \
  -e DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL=demo@demo.demo \
  -e DEFAULT_ADMIN_USERNAME=demo \
  -e DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD=demo \
  -e DEFAULT_ADMIN_NAME="Demo User" \
  -e SECRET_KEY=notasecretkey \
  -e TRUST_PROXY=false \
  -e DEFAULT_LANGUAGE=en-US `#optional` \
  -p 1337:1337 \
  -v /path/to/planka/data:/config \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/planka:latest
